settings.title: Auto-dismiss startup notice
settings.description: Dismisses the startup safety notice in Park on cold boot and QuickBoot screen wake (requires HMG-API startup notice switch on).

settings.title: Startup notice delay (ms)
settings.description: Delay after screen wake before sending startup_notice dismiss (0-10000 ms).

settings.title: Auto seat & wheel climate on EV Ready
settings.description: Applies seat heat, steering wheel heat, or summer ventilation once per drive when EV Ready engages, preserving active Bluelink climate.

settings.title: Driver seat heat High at or below (F)
settings.description: Outside temperature threshold in whole degrees F for High (level 3) seat heat.

settings.title: Driver seat heat Medium at or below (F)
settings.description: Outside temperature threshold in whole degrees F for Medium (level 2) seat heat.

settings.title: Driver seat heat Low at or below (F)
settings.description: Outside temperature threshold in whole degrees F for Low (level 1) seat heat.

settings.title: Auto steering wheel heat
settings.description: Turns steering wheel heat on when outside temperature is at or below the wheel threshold.

settings.title: Steering wheel heat On at or below (F)
settings.description: Outside temperature threshold in whole degrees F for steering wheel heat.

settings.title: Rear left seat heat policy
settings.description: Two-level rear seats automatically map Medium to Low.

settings.title: Rear right seat heat policy
settings.description: Two-level rear seats automatically map Medium to Low.

settings.title: Summer auto seat ventilation
settings.description: Applies front seat ventilation when outside temperature reaches the summer thresholds.

settings.title: Seat ventilation Low at or above (F)
settings.description: Outside temperature threshold in whole degrees F for Low (level 1) ventilation.

settings.title: Seat ventilation Medium at or above (F)
settings.description: Outside temperature threshold in whole degrees F for Medium (level 2) ventilation.

settings.title: Seat ventilation High at or above (F)
settings.description: Outside temperature threshold in whole degrees F for High (level 3) ventilation.

settings.title: Show notice when auto-climate activates
settings.description: Shows a brief head-unit banner summarizing the applied seat/wheel levels.
